cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says the people of Israel who eat the sacrifices are fellow partakers in the altar.
cards.verse_text: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
cards.snippet: …the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?

cards.card_text: THREE fellows in one verse, friend: fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, fellow partakers of the promise, and nobody gets stuck on the side tray.
cards.verse_text: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
cards.snippet: …the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.

cards.card_text: Peter also calls himself a fellow elder and a partaker of the glory to be revealed.
cards.verse_text: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
